subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep the direct image route generic while improving metadata/UI diagnostics, or should `/avatar/{agentId}` expose more specific failure statuses such as oversized or missing?
rationale: The remaining behavior is UX-visible but also changes diagnostics for authenticated local workspace file serving, so automation should not choose the information-disclosure boundary on its own.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic and use metadata plus Control UI surfaces to explain oversized, missing, unsupported, or outside-workspace avatars.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return specific direct-route statuses such as 413 or 400 only after maintainers accept the local file-policy disclosure risk.

options.title: Defer To Linked PR
options.body: Let the open fork PR carry the direction if maintainers first repair its conflicts and validate its security impact.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic and use metadata plus Control UI surfaces to explain oversized, missing, unsupported, or outside-workspace avatars.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined commit history for agent avatar support, avatar size limits, and the current resolver boundary.
